env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
cp go.mod $WORK/go.mod.orig
cp a.go $WORK/a.orig
cp tests/z_test.go $WORK/test.orig
# An invalid staged LoGOs test must block the entire module, including a.go,
# and must not leak any patch bytes to stdout.
! logos next --fix
! stdout '.'
stderr 'preflight test failed'
stderr 'z_test.lgo'
cmp a.go $WORK/a.orig
cmp tests/z_test.go $WORK/test.orig
! exists a.lgo
! exists tests/z_test.lgo
! exists next_tasks.json
rm tests/z_test.go

# The active compiler cannot vouch for the ignored file's rename.
cp ../extra/skipped.go skipped.go
! logos next --fix
stderr 'skipped.go.*not checked|not checked.*skipped.go'
cmp a.go $WORK/a.orig
cmp skipped.go ../extra/skipped.go
! exists a.lgo
! exists skipped.lgo
! exists next_tasks.json
rm skipped.go

# A local replacement is staged from its saved bytes: --fix proves the
# conversion against that frozen copy and changes neither module. An entry
# of the replacement that is not a regular file cannot be saved, so --fix
# refuses it before any patch is emitted.
mkdir ../dep
cp ../depmod/go.mod ../dep/go.mod
cp ../depmod/dep.go ../dep/dep.go
cp ../extra/go.mod.replace go.mod
cp ../extra/a.go.dep a.go
logos next --fix
stdout '^\+\+\+ b/a\.lgo$'
stdout '^\+	dep\.Ping\(\)$'
stderr '^logos next: patch for 1 files'
cmp a.go ../extra/a.go.dep
cmp ../dep/dep.go ../depmod/dep.go
cmp go.mod ../extra/go.mod.replace
! exists a.lgo
! exists next_tasks.json
[symlink] symlink ../dep/link.go -> dep.go
[symlink] ! logos next --fix
[symlink] ! stdout '.'
[symlink] stderr 'local replacement example.com/nextreject/dep: link.go is not a regular file'
[symlink] rm ../dep/link.go
logos next
stderr 'review only'
cp $WORK/go.mod.orig go.mod
cp $WORK/a.orig a.go
rm ../dep/go.mod ../dep/dep.go


# A directory at a .lgo destination would leave the emitted patch
# inapplicable, so --fix refuses instead of describing a conversion that
# cannot be applied.
mkdir a.lgo
! logos next --fix
stderr 'a.lgo'
cmp a.go $WORK/a.orig
exists a.lgo
! exists next_tasks.json
rm a.lgo

# A directory at the plan destination leaves the required plan change with
# no applicable destination, so --fix refuses. --ai-patch still writes the
# plan itself, so it must refuse the same destination.
mkdir next_tasks.json
! logos next --fix
stderr 'next_tasks.json'
! logos next --ai-patch
stderr 'next_tasks.json'
cmp a.go $WORK/a.orig
! exists a.lgo
exists next_tasks.json
rm next_tasks.json

# An existing plan carrying a field the format does not know is refused:
# merging would drop that field, so --fix reports an error, emits no patch
# bytes, and leaves every byte of source and plan untouched.
cp ../extra/plan-unknown-field.json next_tasks.json
cp next_tasks.json $WORK/plan-unknown.before
! logos next --fix
! stdout '.'
stderr '.'
cmp a.go $WORK/a.orig
cmp next_tasks.json $WORK/plan-unknown.before
! exists a.lgo
rm next_tasks.json

# A malformed (truncated) existing plan is refused the same way: the
# command fails, stdout stays empty, and no file changes.
cp ../extra/plan-truncated.json next_tasks.json
cp next_tasks.json $WORK/plan-truncated.before
! logos next --fix
! stdout '.'
stderr '.'
cmp a.go $WORK/a.orig
cmp next_tasks.json $WORK/plan-truncated.before
! exists a.lgo
rm next_tasks.json

# Overlay bytes cannot authorize saved-file updates.
env GOFLAGS=-overlay=../extra/overlay.json
! logos next --fix
stderr 'overlay'
cmp a.go $WORK/a.orig
! exists a.lgo
! exists next_tasks.json

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/nextreject

go 1.27
-- m/a.go --
package sample

import "strconv"

func Parse(s string) (int, error) {
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(s)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return n, nil
}
-- m/tests/z_test.go --
package tests

import "testing"

func oldNil() *int { return nil }

func TestOldNil(t *testing.T) {
	if oldNil() != nil {
		t.Fatal("expected nil")
	}
}
-- extra/skipped.go --
//go:build ignore

package sample
-- extra/overlay.json --
{"Replace":{"a.go":"../extra/virtual.go"}}
-- extra/virtual.go --
package sample

func Parse(s string) (int, error) { return len(s), nil }
-- extra/plan-unknown-field.json --
{
  "version": "logos-next-1",
  "tasks": [],
  "foreign_field": true
}
-- extra/plan-truncated.json --
{
  "version": "logos-next-1",
  "tasks": [
-- extra/go.mod.replace --
module example.com/nextreject

go 1.27

require example.com/nextreject/dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/nextreject/dep => ../dep
-- extra/a.go.dep --
package sample

import (
	"strconv"

	"example.com/nextreject/dep"
)

func Parse(s string) (int, error) {
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(s)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	dep.Ping()
	return n, nil
}
-- depmod/go.mod --
module example.com/nextreject/dep

go 1.27
-- depmod/dep.go --
package dep

func Ping() {}
